summary: Customer is developing a hot polymer extrusion process incorporating an active pharmaceutical ingredient and wants to investigate optical measurement for detecting composition changes in the melt. They have offline assays, but the process interface is hot and may be exposed to material build up. They need an initial comparison plan and questions before choosing a probe.
